name: What is the expected lifespan of a new roof?

mainEntity.name: What is the expected lifespan of a new roof?

acceptedAnswer.text: The lifespan of a new roof largely depends on the material chosen and quality of installation. Standard asphalt shingle roofs typically last 20-25 years. Architectural or laminate shingles can extend this to 30 years or more. Metal roofs are known for their exceptional durability, often lasting 40-70 years, while tile roofs can last 50 years or longer. Regular maintenance and prompt repairs can significantly contribute to maximizing your roof's lifespan, regardless of the material.
acceptedAnswer.description: Roof lifespan varies by material: asphalt shingles 20-25 years, architectural shingles 30+ years, metal 40-70 years, and tile 50+ years.
